description: Audit and optimize Local AI Hub preprocessing. Preserve incremental watcher behavior; never clear every project's cache as a side effect of a major-change heuristic; hash changed candidates and reuse content-addressed file, module, project, and RAG caches; invalidate only stale dependent results.

acceptance_criteria: Trace actual ProjectPreprocessor.PHASES, scheduler, cursor, activity, GPU admission and resource-limit paths before editing.

Schedule active projects across base phases, then RAG/files, then optional phases; schedule inactive projects across the same layers at lower priority; diagnostics remains separately disabled by default.

Foreground agent access refreshes only the matching canonical absolute root's durable activity timestamp; background/internal work never refreshes it; rolling 24-hour expiry and immediate reactivation work.
New foreground activity raises next selection priority; bounded batches rotate projects; active arrivals and high layers cannot starve inactive projects or lower layers.
Restart resumes durable checkpoints without repeating completed work; content changes invalidate only stale dependents and task deduplication remains correct.

Every batch reuses existing path, security, writer-lease, admission, concurrency, batch, CPU/RAM, time, queue, model and GPU controls; limits are never exceeded; preemption/defer never publishes incomplete model/GPU results.

Focused tests cover layering, activity/background exclusion, 24-hour expiry/reactivation, per-root isolation, fairness/starvation, batching, restart/checkpoint, all resource limits and unavailable/preempted resume.
Update relevant docs and INSTALL_PROMPT/UPDATE_PROMPT; report no performance claim without measurement.
